name: Drive profitable revenue growth
description: Expand top-line sales while maintaining or improving net profitability through strategic pricing and fulfillment optimization.
executive_questions: Are we growing sales profitably, or is volume growth eroding margins?

kpis.name: Net Profit Growth
kpis.description: Measures the absolute change in net profit over the period, indicating bottom-line expansion.
kpis.measurement: Percentage change in sum(Profit) compared to the prior period

operational_metrics.name: Sales Growth
operational_metrics.description: Tracks top-line revenue expansion to contextualize profit movement.
operational_metrics.measurement: Percentage change in sum(Sales) compared to the prior period

operational_metrics.name: Average Discount Rate
operational_metrics.description: Reveals pricing pressure that may compress margins.
operational_metrics.measurement: Percentage change in mean(Discount) compared to the prior period

operational_metrics.name: Shipping Cost Ratio
operational_metrics.description: Tracks fulfillment cost efficiency relative to revenue.
operational_metrics.measurement: Percentage change in sum(Shipping Cost) / sum(Sales) compared to the prior period

kpis.name: Profit Margin Delta
kpis.description: Measures the change in net profitability percentage, isolating margin health from volume effects.
kpis.measurement: Percentage change in (sum(Profit) / sum(Sales)) compared to the prior period

operational_metrics.name: Product Base Margin Shift
operational_metrics.description: Reveals changes in inherent product profitability.
operational_metrics.measurement: Percentage change in mean(Product Base Margin) compared to the prior period

operational_metrics.name: Discount Rate Shift
operational_metrics.description: Reveals changes in promotional depth affecting net margins.
operational_metrics.measurement: Percentage change in mean(Discount) compared to the prior period

name: Optimize fulfillment efficiency
description: Reduce logistics costs and improve delivery speed to enhance customer satisfaction and protect margins.
executive_questions: Is our fulfillment strategy driving down costs or increasing them?

kpis.name: Fulfillment Cost per Order
kpis.description: Measures the average logistics cost incurred per order, indicating operational efficiency.
kpis.measurement: Percentage change in mean(Shipping Cost) compared to the prior period

operational_metrics.name: Express Air Adoption Rate
operational_metrics.description: Tracks the proportion of orders using higher-cost express shipping.
operational_metrics.measurement: Percentage change in count_distinct(Order ID) where Ship Mode='Express Air' / count_distinct(Order ID) compared to the prior period

operational_metrics.name: Average Order Quantity
operational_metrics.description: Reveals if larger order sizes are diluting per-unit shipping costs.
operational_metrics.measurement: Percentage change in mean(Quantity ordered new) compared to the prior period

name: Strengthen customer segment performance
description: Identify and capitalize on high-value customer segments to drive sustainable order volume and loyalty.
executive_questions: Which customer segments are driving growth and which are lagging?

kpis.name: Segment Revenue Share
kpis.description: Measures the proportion of total revenue contributed by each customer segment, highlighting strategic focus areas.
kpis.measurement: Percentage change in sum(Sales) for each Customer Segment / sum(Sales) compared to the prior period

operational_metrics.name: Segment Order Volume
operational_metrics.description: Tracks the number of orders per segment to identify demand shifts.
operational_metrics.measurement: Percentage change in count_distinct(Order ID) for each Customer Segment compared to the prior period

operational_metrics.name: Segment Average Discount
operational_metrics.description: Reveals if specific segments require deeper discounts to convert.
operational_metrics.measurement: Percentage change in mean(Discount) for each Customer Segment compared to the prior period
